rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account, then retrieved user and order details. It identified exactly which orders were pending, asked for explicit confirmation and a reason before making changes, and then executed cancellations using the proper tools. The tool results confirm both pending orders were cancelled and refunds issued to the original payment method. The agent did not attempt to change delivered or already-cancelled orders and provided a reasonable refund timeframe. No unsupported or fabricated information affecting the outcome was given. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
